about: The look families (materials) and effect families (casts, fire) the view can draw. A material or spell names one in its own "look" group (an element, cover or gas may give only a colour: "bare"); rules/README.md 'Looks' has the words. An effect family's "own" is the colour its pack effects are drawn in: a spell whose look is another hue has its show turned to it (LookTint), and one with no "own" stays as authored. View only: nothing here reaches the core's state, the cell hash or the rules fingerprint. A family with "drawn": false is named but the view doesn't draw it from data yet; "needs" says what's missing, and a mod can't use it until then.

bare.about: A look with no family: only its colour, which the view reads wherever it draws the thing. An element's is the colour of what it makes in the world, whichever spell or reaction made it (fire's flames, water, cold's frost), and of the casts of its spells that chose no colour of their own; a cover's or gas's is its own, until its family is drawn. The fire families take no colour: every fire's flames are the fire element's colour. "also" is what one table's bare looks take besides: A cover's glow, 0 to 1 (only a cover's: an element's or gas's look takes only its colour): its cells shine in the look's colour after dark (CellSlickMesh's glow film), lit as the lamps are and next to nothing by day. 0.1 is a faint shimmer, 0.3 a clear glow at dusk, 1 the brightest.

creature.about: A thing with no baked prefab (a mod's new kind on entities or items), dressed as one of the fauna's animals, still, in a coat of its colour. No look at all means the thing's own baked prefab, as every kind the rules ship with has.
creature.notes: species is a row of the fauna table (rules/fauna.json, or one a mod adds); scale is against its own size; a colour takes the place of its coat; glow 0.1 is a soft glow that keeps its shading, and 0.4 flattens it: pale by day, a flat cut-out after dark.

ground.about: Flat ground, painted by the land; nothing stands on the cell. A glow (0 to 1) shines over it in its colour after dark.

block.about: A solid block of its own height: stone, a pillar.

spire.about: A cluster of jagged rock spires bursting up out of the cell: one tall and crooked, lower ones leaning out round it. Height is how high the cell stands; the tallest point reaches two to three times that.

plant.about: Something growing on the cell, on its own ground.
plant.notes: A tree or sapling is the valley's own tree model, so it takes no colour there.

debris.about: What's left lying on the cell.

deck.about: A plank deck on two beams.

plate.about: A riveted metal plate, shifted off the grid.

wall.about: A log wall, built by its house or worn thin on its posts.

slick.about: A glossy film lying on the cell in the look's colour, fading at its edge (CellSlickMesh). Every slippery cover and every cover a mod adds wears it without naming the family. A glow (0 to 1) shines over the film in its colour after dark.

scorch.about: Charred ground under the cover, as fire leaves (CellPaint). What sim.json fire.ash or a material's burn.ash names is drawn so without naming the family; a mod's own wears its colour as a film too. A glow (0 to 1) shines over it in its colour after dark.

ember.needs: CellLavaMesh's embers check read from the cover's look

growth.needs: ChemGrid's thorns and vines checks to pick CellThorns or CellVines from the cover's look; their colours already are

vapour.needs: ChemGrid.Effects' prefab per gas to become one particle effect; its tint already comes from the gas's look

bank.needs: FogBank's style per gas read from the gas's look (height, thickness); its colour already is

hand.about: Only the glow in the caster's hand; the ground or the core draws the rest.

bolt.about: A shot from the hand and a small burst where it lands.

cone.about: Flame from the hand along a cone.

blast.about: A thrown bead and an explosion scaled to the burst's radius.

meteor.about: A burning rock from the sky, an explosion and dust scaled to the burst's radius.

beam.about: A beam from the hand along the line.

storm.about: Weather pouring from a low cloud over the burst's cells.

splash.about: A splash of water scaled to the square.

swirl.about: A swirl of air and sand.

shockwave.about: A ring of dust thrown out, scaled to the burst's radius.

motes.about: Slow lights drifting where it lands.

veil.about: The mist, tinted with the look's colour.

bloom.about: Motes drifting up from growing things.

plain.about: The plain flames of a burning cell.

flare.about: A tall, quick flare (thatch, dry stuff).

oil.about: Low, wide flames on a film of oil.
